sozluk.1- SÖZLEŞMENİN KONUSU VE KAPSAMI: 1- SUBJECT AND SCOPE OF THE CONTRACT
sozluk.İşbu sözleşmenin konusu, MÜŞTERİ tarafın: The subject of this contract is to set out the terms of the laser, care and beauty services purchased by the CUSTOMER from the CENTER and detailed below (hereinafter "SERVICE"), the provision of the services, the payment terms, and the rights and obligations of the parties.
sozluk.Nakit, Kredi Kart (tek çekim, taksit), e: Cash, credit card (single payment, instalments), in-house instalments (due dates are specified in the attached payment plan)
sozluk.2.2- Müşteri taksitli işlemlerde ödemele: 2.2- In instalment transactions the Customer is obliged to make payments on the specified due dates. In case of late payment, the CENTER reserves the right to claim statutory interest and to declare the entire remaining debt immediately due.
sozluk.2.3- Hizmet bedeli ödenmeden veya ödeme: 2.3- Whether the service continues to be provided if the service fee is not paid or the payment plan is not followed is at the discretion of the CENTER.
sozluk.3- TARAFLARIN HAK VE YÜKÜMLÜLÜKLERİ: 3- RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS OF THE PARTIES
sozluk.Merkez, hizmeti mesleki standartlara uyg: The Center is obliged to provide the service in line with professional standards and hygiene rules, by qualified staff and to the promised standards, to ensure that the devices and products used comply with standards, and to serve the customer in accordance with the terms of the contract.
sozluk.3.2- MÜŞTERİ'NİN YÜKÜMLÜLÜKLERİ VE SAĞLI: 3.2- OBLIGATIONS OF THE CUSTOMER AND HEALTH DECLARATION
sozluk.Sağlık Beyanı: Müşteri, hamilelik, epile: Health declaration: The Customer must notify the CENTER in writing of all health conditions that may prevent or pose a risk to the service, such as pregnancy, epilepsy, pacemaker, open wounds, skin diseases, cancer treatment, hormonal disorders or regularly used medication.
sozluk.Müşteri, yanlış veya eksik sağlık beyanı: The Customer acknowledges and declares that the CENTER shall not be held responsible for complications, side effects or lack of results arising from an incorrect or incomplete health declaration.
sozluk.İşlem Sonrası Bakım: Müşteri, işlem sonr: Aftercare: The Customer must follow the aftercare instructions given after the treatment (sun protection, contact with water, etc.). The CENTER is not responsible for spots, irritation or lack of results caused by not following the instructions. The Customer acknowledges and declares that this responsibility lies with them and undertakes to follow all instructions fully.
sozluk.Müşteri, MERKEZ'de uygulanan işlemlerin: The Customer acknowledges that the procedures performed at the CENTER are not "medical treatment" or "diagnosis or treatment of disease" but care applications, and that no 100% result guarantee is given (depending on biological factors such as hair structure, hormone balance and skin type). The Customer further acknowledges and declares that the effects of the service may vary according to personal characteristics, that they will not demand a guaranteed result, and that any situation arising from themselves is not caused by the CENTER.
sozluk.4.1- MERKEZ, planlanmış randevulara iliş: 4.1- The CENTER is obliged to send reminder messages about scheduled appointments to the phone number provided by the customer via SMS or WhatsApp.
sozluk.4.2- Müşteri de randevu saatine tam zama: 4.2- The Customer is obliged to arrive on time for the appointment. For delays exceeding 15 minutes, the CENTER has the right to cancel the session or shorten its duration.
sozluk.4.3- Randevu iptali veya erteleme talepl: 4.3- Appointment cancellation or rescheduling requests must be notified to the CENTER at least 24 hours before the appointment time.
sozluk.4.4- Mazeretsiz Gelmeme (No-Show): 24 sa: 4.4- No-show without excuse: If the customer does not attend without giving notice 24 hours in advance, the session is deemed "used, performed" and deducted from the package. In this case the Customer cannot claim any rights. The Customer fully acknowledges and declares this.
sozluk.4.5- Alınan hizmet paketleri, sözleşmede: 4.5- Purchased service packages must be used within the period specified in the contract. The CUSTOMER cannot request an extension for delays caused by their own fault. However, the CENTER may extend the period in case of force majeure or business-related necessities.
sozluk.5- CAYMA HAKKI, FESİH VE İADE KOŞULLARI: 5- RIGHT OF WITHDRAWAL, TERMINATION AND REFUND TERMS
sozluk.5.1- Cayma Hakkı: Müşteri sözleşmenin im: 5.1- Right of withdrawal: The Customer has the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 (fourteen) days from the date of signing, without giving any reason and without paying a penalty, provided that the service has not yet started.
sozluk.5.2- Hizmet Başladıktan Sonra Fesih: Hiz: 5.2- Termination after the service has started: If the contract is terminated for compelling reasons after the service has started (after the first session), the sessions used are calculated at the list price (the single-session unit price, not the discounted package price). The list price of the sessions used is deducted from the total amount paid and the remainder is refunded. However, if the CUSTOMER terminates the contract for arbitrary reasons, this contract becomes immediately due and the amounts paid are not refunded. The Customer declares that they accept this.
sozluk.5.3- MERKEZ'den kaynaklanan kusurlu hizm: 5.3- In case of defective service caused by the CENTER, the CUSTOMER's rights to a refund or re-performance of the service under Law No. 6502 are reserved.
sozluk.6- HİZMETİN DEVİR VE İADESİ: 6- TRANSFER AND REFUND OF THE SERVICE
sozluk.6.1- İşbu yapılan hizmet sözleşmesi sade: 6.1- This service contract binds only the CUSTOMER who signed it. The purchased service cannot be transferred to anyone else.
sozluk.6.2- MÜŞTERİ tarafından alınan hizmet bi: 6.2- The service purchased by the CUSTOMER cannot be sold to another person or used in place of payment.
sozluk.6.3- Müşteri getireceği Resmi Sağlık Kur: 6.3- If the Customer documents with a report from an official health institution that the service definitely cannot be received, the price of the unused sessions is refunded.
sozluk.6.4- Peşin ödemelerde yasal zorunlulukla: 6.4- No refunds are made for advance payments except where required by law.
sozluk.6.5- MÜŞTERİ, kendisi adına uygulanmış o: 6.5- The CUSTOMER cannot use services purchased under a campaign, discount or special price applied in their name on someone else.
sozluk.7.1- MÜŞTERİ, bu sözleşme kapsamında ver: 7.1- The CUSTOMER declares that they give explicit consent for the personal data provided under this contract (identity, contact, health information, before and after photos, videos and photos taken with consent, etc.) to be processed and stored by the CENTER under KVKK Law No. 6698 for the performance of the service, appointment tracking and legal obligations, and to be shared with institutions permitted by law and on the social media accounts managed by the CENTER (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc.).
sozluk.7.2- Müşteri yukarıda belirtilen ve MERK: 7.2- If the Customer does not give explicit consent to sharing content such as videos, photos and images taken for the CENTER's social media accounts as stated above, the KVKK information notice and explicit consent form have been signed together with this contract.
